name: Dimension Drifters
detailed_description:
Dimension Drifters is a hand-drawn 2D anime action-platformer that takes players through intense, multi-dimensional combat. Join the protagonist, Ena on her quest to restore the shattered dimensions torn apart by the mysterious 'Dark Drifter.'

INTRODUCTION

A legend tells that some children possess the ability to slip between dimensions, stepping into realms unseen. But such power comes at a cost. The longer one lingers, the more their soul unravels, until only darkness remains.

One such child became both legend and nightmare. The Dark Drifter. A child who lingered beyond the threshold for too long, gaining unimaginable power. Some say it’s just a story, that it happened a thousand years ago.

But what if it’s true?

If he returns, he won’t return alone. The city will shatter, splintering into fractured dimensions. Families will be torn apart, loved ones lost, trapped in endless, broken worlds. But then again. It’s a story, until…

ENA

Among the few with this dimensional gift is Ena, a young girl with the power to traverse these hidden worlds. To save her city and reunite its people, Ena must face the Dark Drifter, uncover the secrets hidden across each dimension, and restore the balance before it's too late.

HOW IT ALL STARTED

Ena had only meant to take a walk through Ufan Forest. But something called to her. A whisper, a pull from beyond. Before she could understand what was happening, reality shifted, and she found herself standing in another dimension.

A child stood before her, smiling. For a moment, everything was still. Then, the air behind him twisted. A shadow loomed. The Dark Drifter. Before Ena could react, the entity surged forward, passing straight through the child and straight through her. A force unlike anything she had ever felt hurled her backward, and in the blink of an eye, she was back in her own world. But something had changed. Something had followed her through.

She had set the Dark Drifter free.

Her grandmother had once told her the old legend, how some children were born with the ability to drift between dimensions. But those who lingered too long were consumed, lost to the dark forever. Ena had never truly believed it. Not until now. Because of her, the darkness had found its way into their world.

But if she was the one who set it free, then she would be the one to stop it.

To stand with the spirits. To find strength within herself. To fight for her friends. And for those who had already fallen. Fate was in her hands now. She would release the spirits within, for deep in every soul, she knew one truth...

Every spirit is pure.

FEATURES

Multi-Dimensional Combat: Shift between realms mid-fight, chaining slashes, aerial strikes, and spirit arts in seamless flow. Time slows. Gravity bends. Each encounter becomes a dance across dimensions—unpredictable, stylish, and devastating.

Every enemy and boss tells their own story through combat. A unique choreography of strikes, feints, and fury. Defeat them, and their soul is set free… but their battle spirit lingers. Absorb their signature moves and carry their strength into the next fight. Each battle becomes a cinematic duel—part side-scrolling brawler, part spiritual rite.

Ena is just eight years old. No powers, no prophecy, just courage. Each enemy she defeats is a soul she sets free. With every victory, she carries their strength, their moves, their memories. What begins as a fragile child’s fight becomes a growing force of many, one small figure, shaped by hundreds of warriors, facing the darkness with everything she’s earned.
